sloka: स्वानि राज्यानि मुख्यानि ऋद्धानि मुदितानि च ।समृद्धधनधान्यानि पूर्णानि वसुमन्ति च ।। ७.३९.७ ॥
transliteration: svāni rājyāni mukhyāni ṛddhāni muditāni ca ।samṛddhadhanadhānyāni pūrṇāni vasumanti ca ।। 7.39.7 ॥

translations.english: Their own excellent and prosperous kingdoms were joyful, full of abundant wealth and grain, and rich in resources.
